data.name: Pixel Piracy Online
data.detailed_description:
DISCORD + WISHLIST


About the Game

Wishlist and follow Pixel Piracy Online (PPO) Now!

Pixel Piracy Online is an entirely new game set in the same universe as Pixel Piracy; it's a complete remake of the base game. In this game, you assume the role of a pirate, and your purpose is to make a name for yourself.

Pirate MMO

The goal is to create a Pirate MMO that players/pirates can call home; the game is currently in pre/pre-production, and screenshots don't represent the final product yet. You will play alone or with friends, be part of the big pirate community and build the world and gather resources, farm and feed others, socialize, pillage settlements, level up your character and crew, min-max to become the best, loot different epic loot, craft to survive the hostile world and most importantly battle others.

Pixel Piracy Online runs on persistent centralized non-sharded servers that require an internet connection. Ownership of the game gives you access to these online centralized servers.

Key Features

  • Tile-Based Worlds where you can dig and explore caves.
  • Ocean Floor Exploration
  • Online Multiplayer with hundreds of other pirate players.
  • Naval Combat and Ship Building
  • RPG System
  • Guild Wars
  • Social Aspects such as Taverns.
  • Loot System
  • Player vs. Player (PvP) Gameplay
  • Crew vs. Crew Battles (Fort Battle)
  • Role-Playing (RP) and Wholesome Elements

Lore

Pixel Piracy Online's story takes place a super long time after the first Pixel Piracy game. All pirates got wiped out by Holy Mother Shrimp, and now life is starting again with a twist that everyone remembers their past. Here, dead men will tell tales.

data.short_description: Pirate MMORPG with zero microtransactions. Set sail alone or with friends, and build your pirate empire using force or trade. In this pirate simulator game, you write your own RPG story.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.5 GHZ
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512mb Video Memory, capable of Shader Model 2.0+
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
